abilities.name: Charge
per_rank_text:
Charge an enemy, generate 12 rage, and root it for 1.5 sec.

This ability is usable while shapeshifted.

abilities.name: Concussion Blow
per_rank_text:
Stuns the opponent for 5 sec and deals damage. @ext:(based on attack power).:ext@ 

Causes a High amount of threat.

abilities.name: Heroic Leap
per_rank_text:
Leap through the air toward a target location, slamming down with destructive force to deal Physical damage and slow all enemies within 8 yards by 50% for 2 sec. While in the air you are immune to crowd control effects.

@ext:Usable while shapeshifted.:ext@

abilities.name: Titan's Grip
per_rank_text:
Allows you to wield a Two-Handed Axe, Mace, or Sword in each hand. 

Also allows for a weapon or shield to be held in the off-hand while a Staff is equipped.

Physical damage dealt is reduced by 10%.

abilities.name: Berserker Stance
per_rank_text: An aggressive stance. Critical hit chance is increased by 3% and all damage taken is increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Safe Fall
per_rank_text: Reduces damage from falling.

abilities.name: Cloak of Shadows
per_rank_text:
Instantly removes all existing harmful spell effects, Increases your chance to resist all spells by 90% for 5 sec. 

Does not remove effects that prevent you from using Cloak of Shadows.

abilities.name: Kick
per_rank_text:
A quick kick that interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec. 

@ext:This ability shares a cooldown with other interrupts.:ext@

abilities.name: Blink
per_rank_text: Teleports the caster 20 yards forward, unless something is in the way. Also frees the caster from stuns and bonds.

abilities.name: Arcane Intellect
per_rank_text:
Increases the target's Intellect by 2 and spell power by 2 for 30 min.

@ext:Does not stack with other similar effects.:ext@

abilities.name: Cure Toxins
per_rank_text: Cures 1 poison effects and 1 disease effects on a friendly target.

abilities.name: Flametongue Weapon
per_rank_text: Imbue your weapon with fire, increasing total Spell power by 7$?s118150[ and increasing Spell critical strike chance by 2%.][.] Each auto attack and melee ability causes $/77;8026m1 to $/25;8026M1 additional fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. This effect lasts for 2 hours.

abilities.name: Feral Spirit
per_rank_text:
Summons two Spirit Wolves under the command of the Shaman, lasting 45 sec.

@ext:This ability is usable while shapeshifted.:ext@

abilities.name: Consecration
per_rank_text: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 32 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

abilities.name: Crusader Strike
per_rank_text: An instant strike that causes 75% weapon damage.

abilities.name: Exorcism
per_rank_text: Causes 96 to 110 Holy damage to an enemy target. Exorcism always critically strikes Undead and Demon targets. It also stuns them for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Divine Storm
per_rank_text: An instant weapon attack that causes 110% of weapon damage to enemies within 8 yards. The Divine Storm heals up to 3 party or raid members for 25% of the damage caused.

abilities.name: Blessing of Kings
per_rank_text:
Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 30 min. 

@ext:Does not stack with other similar effects.:ext@

abilities.name: Judgement of Light
Seal of Command
per_rank_text: All main hand auto attacks and Paladin melee abilities deal additional Holy damage to the target and up to 2 additional targets. Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing Holy damage.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
per_rank_text:
Heals a friendly target for an amount equal of 100% of your maximum health. The target cannot be targeted by Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, or Lay on Hands again for 2 min.

Cannot be used within 30 sec of using Avenging Wrath.

abilities.name: Light's Hammer
per_rank_text:
Hurl a Light-infused hammer into the ground, where it will blast a 10 yard area with Arcing Light for 10 sec.

Deals Holy damage to enemies and reduces their movement speed by 50% for 3 sec. Also heals up to 5 allies every 2 sec.

abilities.name: Anti-Magic Shell
per_rank_text:
Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell, absorbing 75% of the damage dealt by harmful spells (up to a maximum of 50% of your health) and preventing application of harmful magical effects. 

20% of the absorbed damage by Anti-Magic Shell is granted as additional rage. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Stormcloak
per_rank_text:
|cFFFFFFFFThis spell belongs to |r|cFF0070DEStormbringer|r

Cover yourself in a barrier of volatile energy for 15 sec, causing all attacks against you to have a $h% chance to deal half damage.

|cffffffffStormcloak|r has a 60% chance to resist dispel effects.

abilities.name: Warbreaker
per_rank_text:
Stomp the ground, dealing 90% armor piercing weapon damage to nearby enemies and causing your attacks to pierce 30% of their armor for 10 sec.

@ext:This uses Colossus Smash modifiers.:ext@

abilities.name: Burst of Thorns
Hour of Judgement
per_rank_text:
Causes the Hour of Judgement, making a rain of hammers follow the caster dealing -39 Holy damage every 2 sec to enemies in 10 yards and unleashing a |cFFFFFFFFHammer from the Heavens|r every 0.5 sec.
